context: Ruled on the oracle-rulings appendix: 7 lead decisions + 7 conflicts resolved; added the `reinstated` lifecycle kind (rule capability, class-ranked) for C14 intentional restoration; ADR §2.3/§4.1/§4.3/§4.4/§12/§13 updated; oracle files gained their missing structured open-question sections.
rationale: Resolves the six conflicts the rulings pass found between the ADR text and the independent oracles without editing any oracle: each is a wording or convention clarification with a requirement reason (R01 keeps identity records separate; R05 preserves history; R09 non-interference explains the two arms), and each is now stated in the ADR so the slice and the oracles agree.
summary: `contested` is an annotation (history and explain packets), never a member of the current applicable view and never a change to the target's conflict state; oracle event counts are evaluated over the case's own record types only (principal/membership/observation/receipt excluded); C14 runs two arms (exchange-ref carrier and source-branch mode); `representations[]` lives on the admission-log projection, not the envelope; the admission log records a reason for every outcome; closed uncertainty windows are retained; attachment default 256 KiB
